h5.text: No bill may be voted on the same day it receives its Second Reading, except by unanimous consent of all Delegates present.
h5.question: Under what circumstance may a bill be voted on the same day it receives its Second Reading?
h5.reference: Only if all Delegates present give unanimous consent.

h5.text: The presiding officer is the Speaker of Benches, who may vote only to break ties.
h5.question: Who is the presiding officer and under what condition may they cast a vote?
h5.reference: The presiding officer is the Speaker of Benches, who may vote only to break ties.

h5.text: The Clerk of the Roll keeps the Ledger of Bills.
h5.question: Who keeps the Ledger of Bills?

h5.text: The Provost of Finance certifies any bill that spends money from the Activity Chest.
h5.question: Who certifies any bill that spends money from the Activity Chest?

h5.text: A quorum is twenty (20) Delegates present in the Chamber.
h5.question: How many Delegates must be present in the Chamber to constitute a quorum?

h5.text: The Clerk reads the title aloud at the first session after filing; this is the First Reading.
h5.question: What action does the Clerk perform at the first session after filing, according to the sentence?
h5.reference: The Clerk reads the title aloud at the first session after filing; this is the First Reading.

h5.text: Committees meet in Room 114 during the Thursday Activity Block.
h5.question: In which room do committees meet during the Thursday Activity Block?

h5.text: The committee may: (a) report the bill Favorably, (b) report it with Amendments, (c) table it until the next calendar month, or (d) kill it by a vote of two-thirds of members present.
h5.question: According to the sentence, what majority vote is required for the committee to kill a bill?
h5.reference: A vote of two-thirds of members present.

h5.text: A bill reported out of committee receives its Second Reading no sooner than three (3) school days later.
h5.question: After a bill is reported out of committee, what is the minimum number of school days that must pass before it can receive its Second Reading?

h5.text: Delegates may speak once for up to four (4) minutes; the Sponsor may speak twice.
h5.question: What is the maximum speaking time, in minutes, allowed for a Delegate according to the sentence?

h5.text: The Third Reading occurs immediately after amendments are settled.
h5.question: According to the given sentence, when does the Third Reading occur?
h5.reference: The Third Reading occurs immediately after amendments are settled.
